actual: Lane K pass, Cricmax - Home Location. The class wizard has only 7 steps (Program, Schedule, Coach, Location & Slots, Capacity, Sessions, Preview) and no Price step — there is nowhere to enter a price, so "$20 a session" cannot be produced. The Programs list has no Price column (Class, Schedule, Coaches, Enrolled, Status, Actions). The class overview (Overview, Roster, Schedule & Sessions tabs) has no Price row; program details show only Sport, Age group, Days/Time, Location, Term, Sessions, Coach. No "Needs a price" text appears anywhere; the priceless class created in this pass (QA_AP 576 Class, programs/189) shows no price indicator (status Upcoming). A follow-up look-only check confirmed there is no "Programs v2" area in this build (no sidebar entry, no toggle in Preferences, /programs-v2 redirects to the Dashboard), so no alternate priced-class flow exists. UPDATE 17 Nov 2026 (Cricmax Test_AP — the build changed since 12 Nov): the class wizard for QA Walk Program (Term, templates/93) now has 8 steps INCLUDING a Price step (Program, Schedule, Coach, Location & Slots, Capacity, Sessions, Price, Preview) — identical to Adult Evening Nets. Funding type does not explain the difference; the 12 Nov observation no longer holds. The class overview HAS a Price row: 'PRICE — Needs a price — [Set price] — This class was published before prices. Families cannot enroll online until it has one.' (QA_AP 576 Class, programs/189 — renamed 'QA Walk Program · QA_AP 576 Class' by PRG-032). So 'Needs a price' DOES now appear. The Programs-list Price column was claimed present in this check (class rows showing prices) but is not yet visually verified — re-check pending. The original 12 Nov findings were correct for that build; the priced flows arrived in a later merge (workbook: tickets merged to dev as of 17 Nov morning).
expected: The class wizard has a Price step; the Programs list has a Price column; the class overview has a Price row; an old class with no price shows "Needs a price".
steps: Open Programs > New class and list the wizard steps; look for a Price step.
Check the Programs list columns for a Price column.
Open a class overview and look for a Price row.
Create a class with no price and look for a "Needs a price" indicator.
title: QXR-576: no class pricing surface at all — no Price step, column, or row; no 'Needs a price'
trail: Re-checked 2026-11-17 under Cricmax Test_AP (Batch 3a) — Price step, Price row and 'Needs a price' now present; Price column unverified.
